adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the new logic performs a refresh-token `fetch` to `https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token` and then immediately `prisma.credential.update(...)` before returning a `jsforce.Connection`, with no conditional/expiry check shown. This means every invocation of this code path will hit Salesforce’s token endpoint and write to the same credential row, which can cause excessive refresh calls and potential concurrent update contention.
